when_app_update_is_required: A brand-new renderer/activity interaction not listed in activity-types.json.
A new native capability (camera, microphone provider, offline model, etc.) not already implemented.
A content API major version change.
when_app_update_is_not_required: New courses using existing lesson block types.
New exercises using existing activity types.
New vocabulary, examples, error tags, pronunciation targets or TTS phrases.
Changed mastery thresholds, spaced-review intervals or session mix.
New content packs using the same content API.
